searchText: Possibly related to ^ this inscription spam but are the goerli bootnodes online? I just restarted a couple nodes and they seem to be really struggling to find peers (nodes that've been running for awhile seem to have plenty) hmm they should be, we just synced like 300 goerli nodes over the last ~3days. The 300 nodes are synced and now offline to prep for the shadowfork though, so perhaps that churn in peers is leading to some downtime? Seems like my CLs had an issue and that was my main issue, though I can confirm that these nodes are still taking quite awhile to find EL peers (they each only have a handful of peers so far)
